claim_verbatim: The tests. Each one is a public, dated release a reader can check. Four events would support this reading: the task force report lands before 3 February 2027; an exemption for Treasuries from bank leverage ratios appears; the Fed's bill holdings grow while the long-bond buybacks run through January; and Treasury raises its buyback caps again on 3 February while keeping long-bond sizes flat.
context: Closing tests of the essay, after 'The plan can be tested on 3 February 2027.' The 'reading' is that Treasury and the Fed are running a Treasury twist under a new accord, with Treasury acting on 'superior information' about the Fed's portfolio. Teaser line in the free Substack section: 'the four dated tests that settle it by 3 February 2027.'
source: Substack essay 'Treasury’s Advisers Said Bigger Bond Auctions Are Coming. Treasury Chose Buybacks.', ctindale.substack.com, 5 Nov 2026 17:23 UTC (6 Nov 2026 04:23 AEDT; tests sit in the paid section); same text published free as an X Article by @ctindale 5 Nov 2026 17:33 UTC (https://x.com/ctindale/status/2118396388925128754)
probability_words: his stated tests: four events 'would support this reading' (no likelihood word)
resolution_criterion: Score each of the four events separately as happened / did not happen by end of 3 Feb 2027 US Eastern (4 Feb AEDT): (a) the Fed's Balance Sheet Task Force report or recommendations are published or delivered to the FOMC before 3 Feb 2027; (b) a final or proposed rule exempting Treasuries from bank leverage ratios (SLR/eSLR or Tier 1 leverage) appears; (c) Fed (SOMA) Treasury bill holdings on the last H.4.1 of January 2027 exceed those on the 4 Nov 2026 H.4.1, and Treasury's long-bond buybacks run through January; (d) the 3 Feb 2027 refunding raises buyback caps above the Nov 2026 caps while holding 10-, 20- and 30-year auction sizes unchanged. Direction is right if most of the four happen; record the count.
resolution_rule_fixed: Score each of the four events separately as happened / did not happen by end of 3 Feb 2027 US Eastern (4 Feb AEDT): (a) the Fed's Balance Sheet Task Force report or recommendations are published or delivered to the FOMC before 3 Feb 2027; (b) a final or proposed rule exempting Treasuries from bank leverage ratios (SLR/eSLR or Tier 1 leverage) appears; (c) Fed (SOMA) Treasury bill holdings on the last H.4.1 of January 2027 exceed those on the 4 Nov 2026 H.4.1, and Treasury's long-bond buybacks run through January; (d) the 3 Feb 2027 refunding raises buyback caps above the Nov 2026 caps while holding 10-, 20- and 30-year auction sizes unchanged. Direction is right if most of the four happen; record the count.
resolution_source_planned: Federal Reserve FOMC statements/minutes and press releases (task force), Federal Register / Fed-FDIC-OCC releases (leverage ratio), Federal Reserve H.4.1 (SOMA bills), Treasury quarterly refunding statement and tentative buyback schedule, 3 Feb 2027.
mechanism: A new Treasury-Fed accord (Warsh's 'new Treasury-Fed accord, like we did in 1951') carried out as a Treasury twist: Treasury holds long-bond auction sizes flat, funds the gap in bills, buys long bonds back, and counts on the Fed buying bills, betting the yield spike is energy-driven and fades.
notes: Logged 6 Nov 2026 (within a day of publication). No probability word, so no Brier; scored for direction (count of the four events) and timing. Not queued in inferred-to-confirm.csv because there is no likelihood word to map. Quoted from the free X Article text, which matches the Substack essay. Note: Warsh, not Craig, gave the task force timing ('probably early in the first quarter' of 2027). Related: pl-109, pl-110, pl-123.

claim_verbatim: While the Basel Committee keeps its 100% risk weight on corporate loans and its 0% risk weight on top-rated sovereign bonds, new US investment in tradable industries will not lift the United States from 20th (2024) in the Harvard Atlas of Economic Complexity.
context: Closing argument after Table 4. Section heading: 'Four published measures that will show within three years whether a weaker dollar restores US industry under the Basel Committee’s risk weights.' Table 4 row: 'US rank, Harvard Atlas of Economic Complexity. Current value: 20th (2024). ... Prediction: does not recover while the Basel weights stay, even if tradable investment rises.' X post: 'In 1988 a foreign committee in Basel priced American credit so factories starved. The result is the de-industrialisation of America.'
source: Substack essay 'The Unconstitutional De-industrialisation of America by a Foreign Committee', ctindale.substack.com, 5 Nov 2026 12:14 UTC (5 Nov 2026 23:14 AEDT); X Article 12:28 UTC (https://x.com/ctindale/status/2118319654775193625) and X post 12:29 UTC (https://x.com/ctindale/status/2118319858446389667)
resolution_criterion: Conditional on the Basel 100% corporate and 0% AAA to AA- sovereign weights staying in force (otherwise void). YES (his call right) if no Harvard Atlas of Economic Complexity release published by 5 Nov 2029 ranks the US better than 20th; NO if any release in that window ranks the US 19th or better. Use the Atlas's headline ECI country ranking as published at the time; if the Atlas revises its method and back-series, use the rank as first published for each year.
resolution_rule_fixed: Conditional on the Basel 100% corporate and 0% AAA to AA- sovereign weights staying in force (otherwise void). YES (his call right) if no Harvard Atlas of Economic Complexity release published by 5 Nov 2029 ranks the US better than 20th; NO if any release in that window ranks the US 19th or better. resolution_source_planned: Harvard Growth Lab, Atlas of Economic Complexity country rankings (yearly releases); Basel Framework CRE20.
mechanism: Basel risk weights (100% on unrated corporate loans, 0% on AAA to AA- sovereigns, 50% on first-lien mortgages) price bank credit against industry; a weaker dollar alone (Shelton bond, Miran swap, gold revaluation) raises returns on tradables but leaves the capital charge in place, so US industrial capability does not recover.
notes: Logged 6 Nov 2026. Window 'within three years' fixed as 3 years from publication (5 Nov 2029). Inferred 0.90 from 'will not' per SCORING.md; queued in inferred-to-confirm.csv. He states the reverse as his own kill test (pl-128). Mechanism check on resolution: did tradable investment rise (pl-127) while the rank stayed flat? Related: pl-125, pl-126, pl-127, pl-128.
